title: `bun-version: '2.2'` in CI is not a published Bun version
what: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` uses `bun-version: '2.2'`, which is not a published Bun version.
why: CI workflows were rewritten on 2026-11-03. The bun version pin was not verified against published releases.
impact: CI may fail when trying to install Bun 2.2. Needs a valid published version or removal of the Bun dependency.
